statement: On the set of parities $\{0\mathbb{P}, 1\mathbb{P}\}$ (even/odd), the element $0\mathbb{P}$ (even) is a zero, i.e. absorbing, element for multiplication: for every parity $p$ we have both $0\mathbb{P} \cdot p = 0\mathbb{P}$ and $p \cdot 0\mathbb{P} = 0\mathbb{P}$. Equivalently, the conjunction of left-annihilation and right-annihilation of multiplication by the even parity holds.
